# package apdu

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/apdu"
```

Package apdu decodes and encodes the transport layer control information (TPCI) and the application layer protocol data unit (APCI and data) carried in the TPDU of an L\_Data frame.

A TPDU starts with the TPCI octet; its two low bits are the high bits of the 10-bit APCI. Services with a 4-bit APCI (group values, memory and ADC access, device descriptors) carry a 6-bit parameter in the low bits of the second octet: the "small" value of A\_GroupValue\_Write and \_Response, the octet count of A\_Memory\_Read. Services with a 10-bit APCI carry none.

### func ParseGroupValue

```go
func ParseGroupValue(tpdu []byte) (APCI, GroupValue, error)
```

ParseGroupValue decodes the TPDU of a group value service: it returns the service (GroupValueRead, GroupValueResponse or GroupValueWrite) and, except for reads, the value. Other TPDUs give an error matching knx.ErrUnsupported.

### type APCI

```go
type APCI uint16
```

String names the service, such as "A\_GroupValue\_Write", or "APCI(0x%03X)".

### type GroupValue

```go
type GroupValue struct {
	Data  []byte
	Small bool
}
```

GroupValue is the data of A\_GroupValue\_Write or \_Response. Values of at most 6 bits (DPT 1, 2, 3...) are sent "small", in the APCI octet; Data then holds one octet 0..63.

### type TKind

```go
type TKind uint8
```

TKind is the kind of a transport layer PDU.

```go
const (
	// TData is an unnumbered data PDU (T_Data_Group, T_Data_Broadcast,
	// T_Data_Individual).
	TData TKind = iota
	// TDataTagGroup is T_Data_Tag_Group.
	TDataTagGroup
	// TDataConnected is a numbered data PDU of a transport connection.
	TDataConnected
	// TConnect is T_Connect.
	TConnect
	// TDisconnect is T_Disconnect.
	TDisconnect
	// TAck is T_ACK.
	TAck
	// TNak is T_NAK.
	TNak
)
```

Transport layer PDU kinds. Whether an unnumbered data PDU is T\_Data\_Group, T\_Data\_Broadcast or T\_Data\_Individual follows from the destination address of the frame, not from the TPCI.
